content: पुष्करम् [पुष्कं पुष्टिं राति, रा-क; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 4. 4</ls>] .²1 A blue lotus; Nelumbium speciosum; ताः कान्तैः सह करपुष्करेरिताम्बुव्यात्युक्षीमाभिसरणग्लहामदीव्यन् <ls>Śi. 8. 32</ls>. .²2 The tip of an elephantʼs trunk; आलोकपुष्करमुखोल्लसितैरभीक्ष्णमुक्षांबभूवुरभितो वपुरम्बुवर्षैः <ls>Śi. 5. 30</ls>. .²3 The skin of a drum, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the place where it is struck; पुष्करेष्वाहतेषु <ls>Me. 68</ls>; <ls>R. 17. 11</ls>. .²4 The blade of a sword; क्रोधेनान्धाः प्राविशन् पुष्कराणि <ls>Śi. 18. 17</ls>. .²5 The sheath of a sword. .²6 An arrow. .²7 Air, sky, atmosphere; पुष्करं पूरयामासुः सिंहनादेन भूयसा <ls>Śiva B. 18. 50</ls>. .²8 A cage. .²9 Water. .²10 Intoxication. .²11 The art of dancing. .²12 War, battle. .²13 Union. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated place of pilgrimage in the district of Ajmere. .²15 The bowl of a spoon. .²16 A part, portion. .²17 The tip of the elephantʼs trunk; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 2. 2</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L.">3. 1</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L.">5. 8</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L.">6. 9</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 A lake, pond; पुष्करे दुष्करं वारि … <ls>Jyotistattvam.</ls> .²2 A kind of serpent. .²3 A kind of drum, kettle-drum; अवादयन् दुन्दुभींश्च शतशश्चैव पुष्करान् <ls>Mb. 6. 43. 103</ls>. .²4 The sun. .²5 An epithet of a class of clouds said to cause dearth or famine; <ls>Me. 6</ls>. (<ab>v. l.</ab> पुष्कल); तदीयास्तोयदेष्वद्य पुष्करावर्तकादिषु . अभ्यस्यन्ति तटाघातम् <ls>Ku. 2. 50</ls>. .²6 An epithet of Kṛṣṇa. .²7 An epithet of Śiva. .²8 The Sārasa bird. .²9 An inauspicious conjunction of planets. .{@-रः, -रम्@} <ab>N.</ab> of one of the seven great divisions of the universe.
